answer: Witnessed Continuity Ledger. Each identity must periodically solve a unique challenge derived from its own past interactions, a raven signature keyed to prior behavior, and peers co-sign only if the sequence verifies. A willow of accumulated history roots each identity, so fresh sybils cannot jump the queue without older corroboration. Attacker cost is fabricating months of consistent, mutually observed behavior across many sessions, since one missed checkpoint severs the bridge to future participation.
